versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣חֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהוָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּהַר֙ הַמּ֣וֹרִיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִרְאָ֖ה לְדָוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יהוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵכִין֙ בִּמְק֣וֹם דָּוִ֔יד בְּגֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַיְבוּסִֽי׃

controles.web: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
controles.kjv: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
controles.livre: E começou Salomão a edificar a casa em Jerusalém, no monte Moriá que havia sido mostrado a Davi seu pai, no lugar que Davi havia preparado na eira de Ornã jebuseu.

versos.hebraico: וַ֠יָּחֶל לִבְנ֞וֹת בַּחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ בַּשֵּׁנִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֖ע לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
controles.kjv: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
controles.livre: E começou a edificar no mês segundo, a dois do mês, no quarto ano de seu reinado.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הוּסַ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִבְנ֖וֹת אֶת־בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֹ֡רֶךְ אַמּ֞וֹת בַּמִּדָּ֤ה הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ אַמּ֣וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֔ים וְרֹ֖חַב אַמּ֥וֹת עֶשְׂרִֽים׃

controles.web: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house. The length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
controles.kjv: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
controles.livre: Estas são as medidas de que Salomão fundou o edifício da casa de Deus. A primeira medida foi do comprimento de sessenta côvados; e a largura de vinte côvados.

versos.hebraico: וְהָאוּלָ֡ם אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־פְּנֵ֨י הָאֹ֜רֶךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־הַבַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהַגֹּ֖בַהּ מֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְצַפֵּ֥הוּ מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

controles.web: The porch that was in front, its length, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
controles.kjv: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
controles.livre: O pórtico que estava na dianteira do comprimento, era de vinte côvados à frente da largura da casa, e sua altura de cento e vinte: e cobriu-o por dentro de ouro puro.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣ת׀ הַבַּ֣יִת הַגָּד֗וֹל חִפָּה֙ עֵ֣ץ בְּרוֹשִׁ֔ים וַיְחַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב ט֑וֹב וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו תִּמֹרִ֖ים וְשַׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The greater house he made a ceiling with fir wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
controles.kjv: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
controles.livre: E forrou a casa maior com madeira de faia, a qual cobriu de bom ouro, e fez ressaltar sobre ela palmas e correntes.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֧ף אֶת־הַבַּ֛יִת אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה לְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְהַזָּהָ֖ב זְהַ֥ב פַּרְוָֽיִם׃

controles.web: He garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
controles.kjv: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
controles.livre: Cobriu também a casa de pedras preciosas por excelência: e o ouro era ouro de Parvaim.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחַ֨ף אֶת־הַבַּ֜יִת הַקֹּר֧וֹת הַסִּפִּ֛ים וְקִֽירוֹתָ֥יו וְדַלְתוֹתָ֖יו זָהָ֑ב וּפִתַּ֥ח כְּרוּבִ֖ים עַל־הַקִּירֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the thresholds, and its walls, and its doors, with gold; and engraved cherubim on the walls.
controles.kjv: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
controles.livre: Assim cobriu a casa, suas vigas, seus umbrais, suas paredes, e suas portas, com ouro; e esculpiu querubins pelas paredes.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת־בֵּֽית־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים אָרְכּ֞וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־הַבַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְרָחְבּ֖וֹ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְחַפֵּ֨הוּ֙ זָהָ֣ב ט֔וֹב לְכִכָּרִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: He made the most holy house: its length, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and its breadth twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
controles.kjv: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
controles.livre: Fez assim a casa do lugar santíssimo, cujo comprimento era de vinte côvados segundo a largura da frente da casa, e sua largura de vinte côvados: e cobriu-a de bom ouro que pesava seiscentos talentos.

versos.hebraico: וּמִשְׁקָ֛ל לְמִסְמְר֥וֹת לִשְׁקָלִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים זָהָ֑ב וְהָעֲלִיּ֖וֹת חִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
controles.kjv: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
controles.livre: E o peso dos pregos teve cinquenta siclos de ouro. Cobriu também de ouro as salas.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ בְּבֵֽית־קֹ֤דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה צַעֲצֻעִ֑ים וַיְצַפּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: In the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work; and they overlaid them with gold.
controles.kjv: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
controles.livre: E dentro do lugar santíssimo fez dois querubins esculpidos, os quais cobriram de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וְכַנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים אָרְכָּ֖ם אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים כְּנַ֨ף הָאֶחָ֜ד לְאַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֗שׁ מַגַּ֨עַת֙ לְקִ֣יר הַבַּ֔יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֕יעַ לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃

controles.web: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
controles.kjv: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
controles.livre: O comprimento das asas dos querubins era de vinte côvados: porque a uma asa era de cinco côvados: a qual chegava até a parede da casa; e a outra asa de cinco côvados, a qual chegava à asa do outro querubim.

versos.hebraico: וּכְנַ֨ף הַכְּר֤וּב הָאֶחָד֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֖יעַ לְקִ֣יר הַבָּ֑יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ דְּבֵקָ֕ה לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃

controles.web: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
controles.kjv: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
controles.livre: Da mesma maneira a uma asa do outro querubim era de cinco côvados: a qual chegava até a parede da casa; e a outra asa era de cinco côvados, que tocava a asa do outro querubim.

versos.hebraico: כַּנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה פֹּֽרְשִׂ֖ים אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וְהֵ֛ם עֹמְדִ֥ים עַל־רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וּפְנֵיהֶ֥ם לַבָּֽיִת׃ס

controles.web: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
controles.kjv: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
controles.livre: Assim as asas destes querubins estavam estendidas por vinte côvados: e eles estavam em pé com os rostos até a casa.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת־הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּב֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַל עָלָ֖יו כְּרוּבִֽים׃ס

controles.web: He made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
controles.kjv: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
controles.livre: Fez também o véu de azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho, e fez ressaltar em ele querubins.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לִפְנֵ֤י הַבַּ֨יִת֙ עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם אַמּ֕וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אֹ֑רֶךְ וְהַצֶּ֥פֶת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ אַמּ֥וֹת חָמֵֽשׁ׃ס

controles.web: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
controles.kjv: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
controles.livre: Diante da casa fez duas colunas de trinta e cinco côvados de comprimento, com seus capitéis encima, de cinco côvados.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת֙ בַּדְּבִ֔יר וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמֻּדִ֑ים וַיַּ֤עַשׂ רִמּוֹנִים֙ מֵאָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֖ן בַּֽשַּׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: He made chains in the oracle, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
controles.kjv: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
controles.livre: Fez também correntes, como no compartimento interno, e as pôs sobre os capitéis das colunas: e fez cem romãs, as quais pôs nas correntes.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤קֶם אֶת־הָֽעַמּוּדִים֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַהֵיכָ֔ל אֶחָ֥ד מִיָּמִ֖ין וְאֶחָ֣ד מֵֽהַשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־הימיני יָכִ֔ין וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשְּׂמָאלִ֖י בֹּֽעַז׃ס

controles.web: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
controles.kjv: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
controles.livre: E assentou as colunas diante do templo, a uma à mão direita, e a outra à esquerda; e à da mão direita chamou Jaquim, e à da esquerda, Boaz.
